sloka: न सुहृद्भिर् न च अमात्यैः मन्त्रयित्वा न नैगमैः ।मया अयम् अर्थः सम्मोहात् स्त्री हेतोह् सहसा कृतः ॥२-५९-१९॥
transliteration: na suhṛdbhir na ca amātyaiḥ mantrayitvā na naigamaiḥ ।mayā ayam arthaḥ sammohāt strī hetoh sahasā kṛtaḥ ॥2-59-19॥

translations.english: O maharaja, Ayodhya is filled with cheerless people with deep sighs, agonised voices and pale faces depressed and distressed due to Rama's exile. (Even) elephants and horses look spiritless. For me it (the city) resembles (dejected) Kausalya deprived of her son.
